about: What people chose by hand. `npm run build-pool` builds the movie pool from this, data/seed-movies.txt and TMDB, into the database. movies: the curated list, in rank order; `vibe` is a hand-tuned Taste DNA (the rest are estimated from these), `franchise` a hand-set franchise. sagas: the collections — hand-made, each with a rank ladder; `from` says where its films come from (TMDB collections, a list of Title|Year, a studio, a director or an actor's best-known lead roles), and build-pool turns it into movie ids.
